purpose: Source-derived feasibility check only; no SN fitting, KCOR execution, calibration adjustment, or outcome use
quadrature: linear-interpolate BD17 f_lambda at published filter wavelength rows, trapezoid in angstrom; independent secondary trapezoid on union of SED and filter knots over filter support, with filter linearly interpolated and zero outside supplied range
acceptance: No forced matching or offset. Report both source-derived magnitudes and discrepancies to released RC2 BD17 MAGREF 8.4192. Quadrature difference <=0.0001 mag needed for stable numeric result. A difference >0.005 mag between README-derived RC2 and released RC2 MAGREF prevents claiming the README ZP supplies an exact release KCOR reference. The 0.005 bound is descriptive engineering tolerance, not a fitted science threshold.
scope: No conclusion about WIRC SN calibration uncertainty from this star calculation alone.
